title: Equity Bank oo ugu baaqday Ugandhaysiga ku nool Kenya inay lacagaha ay diraan u beddelaan maalgashi
summary: Equity Bank Uganda iyo ururka Uganda Network (UGNET) ayaa Nairobi ku qabtay shir maalgashi oo loogu talagalay Ugandhaysiga ku nool Kenya, kaas oo lagu boorriyay inay ka gudbaan lacag u dirista qoysaskooda oo ay galaan maalgashi muddo dheer ah, sida ay werisay Nile Post.
originalTitle: Equity Bank urges Ugandans in Kenya to turn remittances into long-term investments
imageNote: Ma jiro sawir xor ah oo Equity Bank ama shirka Nairobi ah; sawirrada Nile Post xuquuqdoodu way xifdisan tahay

en.title: Equity Bank urges Ugandans living in Kenya to turn remittances into investments
en.summary: Equity Bank Uganda and the Uganda Network (UGNET) held an investment forum in Nairobi for Ugandans living in Kenya, urging them to move beyond sending money home to their families and make long-term investments, Nile Post reported.

ar.title: بنك إكويتي يحث الأوغنديين المقيمين في كينيا على تحويل الحوالات إلى استثمارات
ar.summary: عقد بنك إكويتي أوغندا وشبكة أوغندا (UGNET) منتدى استثمارياً في نيروبي للأوغنديين المقيمين في كينيا، حثّهم على تجاوز إرسال الأموال إلى أسرهم والاتجاه إلى استثمارات طويلة الأجل، وفق ما أفاد موقع Nile Post.

fr.title: Equity Bank exhorte les Ougandais vivant au Kenya à transformer leurs transferts d'argent en investissements
fr.summary: Equity Bank Uganda et le réseau Uganda Network (UGNET) ont organisé à Nairobi un forum d'investissement destiné aux Ougandais vivant au Kenya, les incitant à aller au-delà des envois d'argent à leurs familles et à investir à long terme, selon Nile Post.

nl.title: Equity Bank roept Oegandezen in Kenia op geldovermakingen om te zetten in investeringen
nl.summary: Equity Bank Uganda en het Uganda Network (UGNET) hielden in Nairobi een investeringsforum voor Oegandezen die in Kenia wonen, waarin zij werden aangespoord verder te gaan dan geld naar hun families sturen en te investeren op lange termijn, meldt Nile Post.

it.title: Equity Bank esorta gli ugandesi in Kenya a trasformare le rimesse in investimenti
it.summary: Equity Bank Uganda e la rete Uganda Network (UGNET) hanno organizzato a Nairobi un forum sugli investimenti per gli ugandesi che vivono in Kenya, invitandoli ad andare oltre l'invio di denaro alle famiglie e a investire a lungo termine, secondo Nile Post.

de.title: Equity Bank ruft in Kenia lebende Ugander auf, Rücküberweisungen in Investitionen umzuwandeln
de.summary: Equity Bank Uganda und das Uganda Network (UGNET) veranstalteten in Nairobi ein Investitionsforum für in Kenia lebende Ugander und riefen sie auf, nicht nur Geld an ihre Familien zu schicken, sondern langfristig zu investieren, berichtete Nile Post.

tr.title: Equity Bank, Kenya'da yaşayan Ugandalıları havalelerini yatırıma dönüştürmeye çağırdı
tr.summary: Nile Post'un haberine göre Equity Bank Uganda ve Uganda Network (UGNET), Kenya'da yaşayan Ugandalılar için Nairobi'de bir yatırım forumu düzenleyerek onları ailelerine para göndermenin ötesine geçip uzun vadeli yatırım yapmaya çağırdı.

es.title: Equity Bank insta a los ugandeses que viven en Kenia a convertir sus remesas en inversiones
es.summary: Equity Bank Uganda y la red Uganda Network (UGNET) celebraron en Nairobi un foro de inversión para los ugandeses que viven en Kenia, en el que se les animó a ir más allá del envío de dinero a sus familias y a invertir a largo plazo, según Nile Post.
